response.path_description: Learn to query, join and aggregate data so you can answer business questions straight from a database.

milestones.title: Relational Databases and SELECT
milestones.description: Tables, rows, columns, and writing your first SELECT queries with WHERE and ORDER BY.

milestones.title: Filtering and Functions
milestones.description: LIKE, IN, BETWEEN, NULL handling, CASE expressions, and date functions.

milestones.title: Aggregations with GROUP BY
milestones.description: COUNT, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY and HAVING to summarise data.

milestones.title: JOINs
milestones.description: Inner, left and full joins; joining three tables; spotting duplicated rows from a bad join.

milestones.title: Subqueries and Window Functions
milestones.description: CTEs, subqueries, ROW_NUMBER, running totals and period-over-period comparisons.

milestones.title: Query Performance
milestones.description: How an index works, reading EXPLAIN output, and writing queries that scale.
